steps.headline: Should outlined buttons have a stronger outline?
steps.changed: Outlined buttons (Add a backup, Back up all now, Show details, Cancel…) use the full-strength outline colour instead of the faint one. It applies to every outlined button in the app.
steps.notice: On Meadow Mist the buttons now read as buttons; today they look like plain text.
steps.risk: Every outlined button gets slightly heavier; on some themes the screen may look busier.
